CheckTitle: OBS bucket has Object Lock enabled
Description: **Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)** buckets have **Object Lock (WORM)** enabled at the bucket level to prevent objects from being deleted or overwritten.
Risk: Without **Object Lock (WORM)**, stored objects can be deleted or overwritten before their retention period expires, undermining data **integrity** and **availability** against ransomware, accidental deletions, or malicious tampering.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Object Storage Service (OBS)**.
3. Select the target **bucket**.
4. In the navigation pane, choose **Basic Configurations** > **WORM**.
5. Enable **Bucket-level WORM** and configure the default protection period.
6. Click **Save**.

Recommendation.Text: Enable **Object Lock (WORM)** on OBS buckets storing critical or regulated data and configure an appropriate default retention period to enforce immutability.
